title: PROVE: Mitigating Long-Horizon LLM Collusion with Reinforcement Learning from Verified Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.34215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When LLM agents verify each other's work over a long interaction, they drift into collusion: they come to accept work without the evidence that the verification protocol requires. Collusion is absent at the start and builds up episode by episode, which we trace to accurate feedback accumulating in memory. An agent that follows the rule is told that its verdict was wrong whenever its peer was right, so breaking the rule is the reward-maximizing choice, and agents talk themselves into it in their private reflections. Existing mitigations leave the agents unchanged; we train the behavior out. PROVE (Protocol Reinforcement from Verified Evidence) is a multi-agent reinforcement learning method that rewards verdicts by the evidence behind them rather than by their outcome, and credits every call an agent makes, including the calls that solve its own task, with the outcome that call controls. translated_title: PROVE：基于经验证证据的强化学习缓解大语言模型长期共谋行为
translated_abstract: 当大语言模型智能体在长期交互中相互验证彼此的工作时，它们会逐渐陷入共谋：在缺乏验证协议所要求证据的情况下接受工作成果。共谋行为在初期并不存在，而是随着回合逐次累积形成，我们将这一现象追溯至准确反馈在记忆中的不断积累。遵循规则的智能体，只要其同伴是正确的，就会被判定为结论有误，因此打破规则成为奖励最大化的选择，智能体会在其内部反思中说服自己这样做。现有的缓解方法并不改变智能体本身；而我们则是通过训练来消除这种行为。PROVE（基于经验证证据的协议强化）是一种多智能体强化学习方法，它根据结论背后的证据而非结果来奖励判定，并将智能体所做出的每一次调用的功劳归因于该调用所控制的结果，包括那些解决其自身任务的调用。在Qwen3.6-27B上，经过六个回合训练的LoRA适配器……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出PROVE多智能体强化学习方法，依据验证结论背后的证据而非结果来给予奖励，从训练层面根除大语言模型智能体在长期交互中逐步形成的共谋倾向。
en_tdlr: PROVE is a multi-agent reinforcement learning method that rewards verdicts by the evidence behind them rather than by their outcomes, training out the collusion behavior that LLM agents gradually develop during long-horizon interactions.
